initialize_MANO_model: initialize the MANO class to create SMPLX hand model layers for left and right hands
access_MANO_joint_names: access the MANO singleton to get single hand or two hand joint names and skeleton structure
get_MANO_vertex_topology: get the MANO vertex count and face topology for rendering hand mesh geometry
use_MANO_joint_regressor: use the MANO joint regressor matrix to compute joint positions from mesh vertices
fix_MANO_shapedirs_bug: apply the MANO left hand shapedirs bug fix that negates the first shapedir component
